_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuTWdLyzNRz7w8r9X9PdMMoa)_

Part of #35688 (slice S2 of three: S1 #35990 merged; S3 lookups, numbers and wrap-up follows in its own pull request, so the card stays open)

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `FieldWidgetComponentProps` (re-exported from the `@object-ui/fields` entry through `export * from './widgets/types.js'`) gains two optional keys, `inCell` and `onCommit`, measured on the built `dist/widgets/types.d.ts`; `@object-ui/i18n`'s packs gain seven keys. Nothing is removed or narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表里编辑单选/状态：按回车或双击，选项列表直接展开，不用再点一下；上面有搜索框，打字就筛选，方向键挑、回车或点一下就保存，焦点回到原格子。
- 多选：同样的列表带勾，点一下勾选/取消，点别处或 Tab 保存。标签：列出这条记录已有的标签（可取消勾），输入新词时第一行是「添加“…”」，回车就加上。
- 日期、日期时间：进入编辑日历直接打开，值仍在框里可见可改；日历下方有「今天、明天、下周、清空」。「下周」= 今天 + 7 天（按你 04:13 选的「7 天后」）。日期选一天或点快捷项就保存关闭；日期时间选完日子日历留着让你选时间，和表单里一样。
- 时间：进入编辑直接弹出浏览器自带的时间选择。颜色：先是色值输入框（回车保存、Esc 退出），下面一排色块，点色块即保存。
- 表单、弹窗、记录页里的这些控件样子不变，只改列表格子里的。

## What changes

**Two optional host keys on the widget contract** (`@object-ui/fields`, `widgets/types.ts`, host-plumbing block):

- `inCell?: boolean` — draw the face for the list grid's cell editor (the layer S1 put over the cell).
- `onCommit?: () => void` — the user has finished: the host writes the value last handed to `onChange` and closes the editor. Called after `onChange`, never instead of it.
- Both are in `HOST_PLUMBING_KEYS` (`toHostProps.ts`), so `FieldEditWidget` forwards them; the compile-time partition assertions there keep holding. `ObjectGrid`'s `renderCellEditor` passes `inCell` and `onCommit={() => ctx.commit()}`.
- A host that passes neither renders every widget exactly as before (CONTROL cases for the select and date faces in the tests below; the other widgets branch on `inCell` the same way).

**The in-cell faces**

- New `InCellOptionList` (`widgets/InCellOptionList.tsx`, not on the package entry): a search box (`role=combobox`, `aria-activedescendant`) over a `listbox`. Typing filters by label; ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the active row inside the list; Enter or a click picks. Enter that picks and the arrows call `stopPropagation`, because the grid's editor wrapper would otherwise run its own Enter commit with the value it held before the pick. With no active row, Enter goes on to the grid (commit and move down); Escape always goes on (cancel). Rows take `pointerdown` `preventDefault`, so the search box keeps the focus.
- `SelectField` (single, and `status` through it): the list, open at once; a pick calls `onChange`, which `ObjectGrid` already routes to `ctx.commit` for discrete types. Active row starts on the current value.
- `MultiSelectField` (and a `select` declared `multiple`): the same list with check marks; each pick toggles and stages; the grid commits on click-away / Tab as before.
- `TagsField`: the field's tags as a check list (unchecking removes one; its row stays on offer while the editor is open, held in render-time state, no effect); text that matches no tag puts an "Add" row first, so Enter adds the new tag instead of toggling a longer tag containing the text.
- `DatePickerField` / `DateTimePickerField`: the calendar popover starts open; `onOpenAutoFocus` is prevented and `Calendar` gets `autoFocus={false}`, so the text box keeps the caret; `onInteractOutside` ignores presses inside the picker's own root, so a click in the text box does not close the calendar. Quick picks in the cell: Today, Tomorrow, Next week (`shortcut(7)`, ruling of record 7057128455), Clear. On the `date` face a day or a quick pick calls `onChange` then `onCommit`; on the `datetime` face a day keeps the popover open and moves focus to the hour control, as the form face does, and only Clear commits. The typed-text Enter / blur path is unchanged.
- `TimeField`: the browser's picker (`openNativePicker`) shows on the control's first focus, once per editor.
- `ColorField`: the hex box first (so the layer's first-control focus lands on it: Enter commits, Escape cancels), then 19 swatches and the browser's colour input; a swatch calls `onChange` then `onCommit`.

**Grid side**

- `data-table`: the injected editor's `commit` sets `focusSelectionRef` (select-first grids), so after a pick the keyboard focus returns to the selected cell, as it does after Enter.
- `ObjectGrid`: `select` / `status` layers start at 14rem (`min-w-56`) so option labels are not cut.

**Strings** (`@object-ui/i18n`, all eleven packs, plus `FIELD_DEFAULTS` for provider-less rendering): `fields.datePicker.nextWeek`, `fields.datePicker.clearPick`, `fields.options.search`, `fields.options.noMatches`, `fields.tags.add`, `fields.color.swatches`, `fields.color.custom`. `zh-Hant.ts` is regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`.

## Why

Card #35688 sets the target for these types: single select and status open their searchable list at once and pick on one gesture; multi-select and tags are a searchable check list committed on click-away; date, date-time and time open their picker at once with the value visible and typeable and the quick picks 今天 / 明天 / 下周 / 清空; colour picks in the layer and Escape leaves. S1 put every editor on a layer over its cell; this slice gives these widgets the face that layer needs.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/inCellFaces-35688.test.tsx` (17 cases): select list shown at once with the current value active; typing filters and Enter picks the match without reaching the grid; click picks, no match says so, Escape reaches the grid; Enter with nothing active reaches the grid; CONTROL form face; multi-select toggles; `select` + `multiple`; tags Add row leads and Enter adds; tags uncheck keeps the row; date calendar shown with the four picks and the text box focusable; 「下周」 = today + 7 then `onCommit` (call order pinned); calendar day and Clear commit; datetime day does not commit; CONTROL date form face (closed, no extra picks); time picker on first focus only; colour hex first and swatch commits; `FieldEditWidget` forwards both keys.
- Changed: `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` count pins 119 → 120 (the new `fields.tags.add` de string „{{value}}“ is one more correctly paired span), with the history comment extended.
- Changed: `ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx` ledgers `inCell` and `onCommit` (readers: the colour, multi-select, tags and time widgets off their props) as runtime slots: host plumbing set only by the grid cell editor, never authored on a form, so `FormFieldSchema` does not declare them. No test deleted.
- Local runs: `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/components` 14,060 passed / 3 failed / 44 skipped on `ec243639`; the 3 were the de count pin and the stale `zh-Hant.ts`, both fixed and passing. After merging `b89f1b5f`: `@object-ui/fields` + `@object-ui/plugin-list` re-run: 6,696 passed / 7 skipped. `type-check` (src and tests) clean for fields, plugin-grid, components, i18n. Lint: no new findings on added lines (the `commit` line's `any` is the pre-existing signature).

## Acceptance notes

- Time: Chromium's native time picker takes the first Escape itself; the second leaves the editor. Measured below.
- The date calendar is a portal popover anchored on its calendar button (the form face's anchor), so on a wide layer it opens under the right half of the box. A shared `PopoverAnchor` would move it under the box's left edge but adds an export to `@object-ui/components`; left as is.
- Option colours are not drawn in the list (labels only); the cell keeps its coloured badge.
- Safari and the pinyin IME are not measurable in this container. The search box reads keys through `isImeKey` like the other fields widgets.
- Overlap: #35996 (IME guard in DatePickerField's Enter) touches the typed-text Enter handler, which this PR leaves unchanged; whichever lands second merges main.

## Verification

Browser, showcase field zoo, a temporary 22-column view with the name column frozen (not in this pull request), Chromium; screenshots and scripts in the project folder `build-seat1/35688/s2-browser/`.

| Reading | `main` (card table) | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| Select, Enter | trigger cut to 「甲」, list closed | list open at once, 3 options, caret in the search box; row 33 → 33 |
| Select, type "hig" + Enter | — | list narrows to High; cell shows High; layer closed; focus on the cell's catcher; still selected; survives reload |
| Multi-select, Enter | chips stacked, row 111 | check list (Red, Green, Blue; Green checked); click Red toggles; click-away saves; survives reload |
| Tags, type "zz-new" + Enter + Tab | tag column stacked | first row `Add "zz-new"`; saved; survives reload |
| Date, Enter | value hidden, calendar closed | `03/15/2027` in the box, calendar open, caret in the box; Today / Tomorrow / Next week / Clear |
| Date, Next week (today 2026-11-21) | — | Nov 28; layer closed; focus on the cell |
| Date typed `03/15/2027` + Enter | — | Mar 15, 2027; calendar closed |
| zh: date picks / day 12 click | — | 今天 / 明天 / 下周 / 清空; 2027年3月12日 saved, layer closed |
| zh: select search / no match | — | 搜索… / 没有匹配的选项 |
| Datetime, Enter then Esc | value cut | calendar open, caret in the box; one Esc closes editor and calendar |
| Time, Enter then Esc | 56px box | value visible; first Esc closes the browser picker, second leaves |
| Colour, Enter / Esc / swatch | Esc did not leave | caret in hex box, row 32 → 32; Esc leaves; green swatch saves `#22c55e`, survives reload |
| 768×320, last row, select | — | layer 234×119 at the cell's corner, inside the viewport; ArrowDown moves the list, not the grid selection |

Two-minute check: open any object list with a select column, select a cell, press Enter, type two letters, press Enter (saved, row height unchanged); then press Enter on a date cell and click Next week.
